endpoint.transport: HTTPS; loopback HTTP permitted for local tests

modelSelection: server configuration per inputType; never client paths or automatic fallback

success.value: canonical piece placement only, eight ranks from a8 to h1

errorSchema.message: nonempty human-readable string; clients branch on code

processingResponseHeaders.X-BoardSnap-Model-SHA256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the selected model file
processingResponseHeaders.X-BoardSnap-Config-SHA256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the fixed model configuration file

parity.success: exact JSON object equality with CLI using identical input bytes/model/mode/orientation
parity.failure: same error code and corresponding HTTP status; messages may differ
parity.diagnosticHeaders: required on recognition results, including decoder/detection errors; optional before a valid mode has been selected

acceptanceEvidence: Eight real HTTPS/CLI parity cases and thirteen real request/CORS checks pass locally. This is transport verification, not final recognition acceptance.
